notes.title: Post Apocalyptic Mayhem Update Released
notes.notes:
Updates to Post Apocalyptic Mayhem have been released. The updates will be applied automatically when your Steam client is restarted. The major changes include:

- New holiday themed Wasteland track
- 7 new holiday achievements
- And a few other surprises!

notes.title: New update released
notes.notes:
1) DLC Compatibility. Players without the DLC can play with players who bought DLC but can’t select the DLC vehicles.
2) Vehicle and Track Change in Multiplayer Lobby. A player can change their track or vehicle without leaving the lobby.
3) Client Kicking in Multiplayer Lobby. A host can delete any client in the lobby.
4) Random Track and Vehicle Selection. Select a random track or vehicle before you race.

notes.title: Post Apocalyptic Mayhem Update Released
notes.notes:
Updates to Post Apocalyptic Mayhem have been released. The updates will be applied automatically when your Steam client is restarted. The major changes include:
New features
New Leaderboards (plus updated)
Online wins
Single Player Wins
High Score
Total Score
Total Kills
Total Laps
Game Percentages
Visible active hosts
Japanese localization
Fixed
Chat positioning on wide screen resolutions
Incorrect binding of F1 button instead of Y button for View Vehicle Abilities
Missing sounds in the host build when the race starts automatically
Incorrect race modes in the Top Dog and Kamikaze descriptions in all the localizations (except English)

notes.title: PAM update released
notes.notes:
New feature: customizable controls (keyboard and non – xbox controllers)
New feature: multiplayer in-game chat (enabled by pressing Y key)
New leaderboard: Winning Percentage which shows a ratio of wins per games
Update: Current leaderboards has been transformed to High Score
Update: Random distribution of vehicles in Quick Game
Fixed: Boost motion blur has been adjusted
Fixed: General physics tweaks
Fixed: Graphical artifact with waiting for game to start in the French localization

notes.title: New Release - Post Apocalyptic Mayhem
notes.notes:
Post Apocalyptic Mayhem is now available on Steam and is 20% off until March 24th, 10AM PDT!

Battle online and lay waste to other racers in over-the-top vehicular mayhem! 

Pick-up the three-pack and get two more friends in on the action!
